array.string: exec >"$HOME/Library/Logs/i9-tunnel.log" 2>&1; for port in {3000..3099} {54321..54324}; do forwards+=(-L "$port:127.0.0.1:$port"); done; exec /usr/bin/ssh -N -p 2222 -l i9-tunnel -i "$HOME/.ssh/i9-tunnel" -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o BatchMode=yes -o HostKeyAlias=i9 -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o ServerAliveInterval=15 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 "${forwards[@]}" i9
